reasons.claim: Notification is a 4.32 ha polygon (Föryngringsavverkning, Rättvik), status 'Anmält för avverkning'.
Completed fellings overlap only 0.109 ha (2.5%) from 2019 and 2022 fellings, far below the 50% threshold; the site is not already felled.

One eligible species is recorded within 250 m: Alectoria sarmentosa (garnlav), VU, a site-bound forest lichen with felling-relevant threats (lack of continuity forest, lack of large/old trees, changed stand structure and tree composition). Records are at 244 m and 250 m, 10 m uncertainty, year 2017.

Four site-bound forest NT species are also recorded within 250 m: Ramboldia elabens, Hertelidea botryosa, Carbonicola anthracophila (all 179 m, 2024) and Hydnellum peckii (239 m, 2017). Four meets the rubric's separate MEDIUM threshold of three, independent of the VU record.
Effort is adequate (310 records, 12 observation days within 1000 m; 90th percentile), with 7 records within 250 m and none inside the polygon.

uncertainties: The eligible VU records lie at the edge of the 250 m ring (244 and 250 m) and date from 2017, so HIGH rests on distance and age that are not strongly close or recent.
No records inside the polygon, so presence on the felling area itself is unknown; the records show the species were recorded nearby, not that they occupy the site today.
not_established: That the species occupy the polygon or that felling would affect them.
Red List category describes extinction risk, not legal protection.
Nothing here establishes the stand's ecological value, or legality of the felling, or that it is safe to fell.
next_action: Send for human ecological review before felling can begin: check the VU lichen and 2024 NT lichen records on GBIF against the polygon and neighbouring habitat, and consider a field visit to judge whether the habitat extends into the stand.
